tei:div.tei:p: 227) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi cha lag bskyed rdzogs las rim rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i cho ga dngos grub 'byung gnas bzhugs: 228)(Dakini secret letter here) na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: rang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: rnal 'byor dam tshig dang ldan pas: bskyed rdzogs lam la 'jug pa'i thabs: las rim 'jug pa'i cho ga bstan: sa ma ya: snyigs dus nyi shu kha ral dus: bskyed rdzogs gding bral zob brdzu mang: grub rtags phra zhing bar chad nye: rim gnyis nyams blangs gang zag ni: shin tu dkon pa'i dus gnas tshe: bskyed rdzogs las rim zab mo 'di: skal ldan 'jug pa'i chos su bkod: 'dir brtson rim gnyis lam mthar phyin: don gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs rmad byung: las rim bcu gsum bstan pa la: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni ma bcos he ru ka: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i gshed: gsang sngags sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: chang bu glud gtor 'di longs la: gsang ba'i gnas 'di+er ma 'dug par: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: bdag nyid khro bo'i brtul zhugs kyis: bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ta re: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: drag sngags hūm̐ bzhi brjod nas thun gyis brabs: gnyis pa srung gur sgom pa ni: 229)hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid drag po'i thugs las rab 'phros pa'i: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram dang: 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gur dang rwa bas bskor: dgra gdon bgegs tshogs gang gis glags mi rnyed: ye shes lnga yi gur khang lhun gyis grub: ye shes bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma tig ṇa dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa yaṃ rak+ṣa khaṃ rak+ṣahūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: gsum pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hoḥ rang byung ye shes byang chub sems: lha dang rang snang gnyis su med: ye shes chen po gsal ba'i sgo: mngon gyur ngang gnas chen por dbye:

badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: rang byung lhun grub rdzogs pa che: dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bor gnas: ma rig dbang gis don ma mthong: da ni rang rig rang zhal mjal: don dam lhan skyes ye phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: lnga pa dam bca' gzung ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig stong bde ba chen po'i klong: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med lha: ye nas dbyer med yi dam bca': srog gi gta' ru gzung bar bya: badz+ra tsit+ta āḥ 230) drug pa byin chen dbab pa ni: spos bsregs rol mo snyan dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ byin chen ngo mtshar gnas kyi mchog: sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nas: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dang: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho spyan 'dren gshegs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: rang snang rnam dag zhing khams nas: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lha: dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog= bgegs dang= mchog dang= byin chen ngo mtshar= chos dbyings mtha' bral zhing khams nas: lhun grub bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje gang 'dul skur bzhengs pa: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dpal: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i lha tshogs rnams rtsa gsum gang yin kha bsdur bya/ mchan/ gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog= bgegs dang= mchog dang= byin chen ngo mtshar= rig stong chos sku'i zhing khams nas: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med lha: gnas 231) gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'jig 'das dam can srung mar bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog= bgegs dang log= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rlobs:

gnas dang sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad: ye shes chen por byin chen phobs: byin chen rnams kyis byin phebs la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: 'ja' lus chen po'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang byung ye shes byang chub sems: thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med: zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sprin: phyi nang gsang mchod bla med rdzas: rang byung ye shes chen por shar: nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs pas: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs khyab gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ=sogs: shap+da ru pa sogs: spar+she dharma sarba pañca a mṛ ta bha liṃ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa dkyil 'khor 'jug bshags ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: lhag pa'i 232)lha tshogs zhal ma mjal: mngon zhen 'khor bar 'phyan pa'i las: dag mnyam chos sku'i klong du bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya shudhe āḥ de nas dngos gzhi sgom pa ni: rtsa gsum gang 'jug gzhung ltar bya: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig tu: gsal dag brtan gsum ldan pa'i ngang: dgu pa spyan 'dren bya ba la: spos bsregs rol mod byangs bsnyan gyis: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag skye med chos sku'i zhing khams nas: rig stong chos sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: lhun grub bde ba chen po'i zhing= gsal stong longs sku'i lha= thugs rje 'gyur ba med pa'i zhing= snang stong sprul sku'i lha tshogs= bde stong ye shes chen po'i klong yangs nas: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: gnas mchog 'di ru spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i zar bu ta la la: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu: sgra dang rol mo'i skad snyan lhangs se lhang: byin rlabs dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li:

gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dam ye dbyer med bzhugs: sgo gsum dag rdzogs smin grol mthar phyin nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki 233)ni ha ri ni sa sarba sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bcu pa bzhugs gsol bya ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings nas drangs pa'i ye shes lha'i: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dpal: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang: dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: sku dang ye shes rang zhal sprod: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: rang byung rig pa chos kyi sku: dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bo ru: mngon gyur ngang gnas chen por sangs: rang byung nyid du ye phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gnyis pa mchod pa bya ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag gdangs las lhun grub rtsal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol: nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg: gsang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang: yang gsang sbyor sgrol kho na nyid: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog gi dngos grub stsol: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin sa ru sgrol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ=sogs: shap+da rū pa sogs: spar+she sarba pū dza bā hiḥ ma hā pañca 234)a mṛ ta khā hiḥ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ ma hā sarba ta na ga ṇa sarba dharma dhā tu pañca pū dza la khā hiḥ bcu gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyis las: lhun grub bde ba chen po longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje thabs mkhas gang 'dul sprul pa ngom: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsung dbyangs 'gag med yan lag drug cu'i sgras: mun 'thug sgrib bcom ye shes rang gsal 'bar: dran pas mun sel 'gag med brda yi gsung: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i gsung la= smra bsam brjod bral shes rab pha rol phyin:

spros bral rnam thar gsum ldan 'dus ma byas: mkhyen gzigs ye shes yon tan ma lus rdzogs: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i thugs la= gzhan yang dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: yongs shar sgyu 'phrul zhi dang khro bo'i tshogs: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho ma lus bcas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas nongs pa bshags phyir yi ge brgya pa brjod nas bsnyen dmigs la 'jug go: sa ma ya: e ma yang zab mkha' 'gro'-i thugs bcud 'di: pad+ma bdag gis mtsho 235)rgyal khyod la gdams: da dung ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus: khyod sprul gter spyod ḍā ki chu khams pa: pad+ma'i rigs can yos sam 'brug lo pa: mdo smad srin yul phyogs su gdul bya skyong: nga min nga 'dra'i thabs kyi grogs dang 'phrad: chos kyi bdag po nam snying sprul pa 'byung: de dus chos 'di'i gtad rgya dus la babs: gter bdag srung mas las ldan bu la sprad: 'gro don bstan pa shar lho nub nas 'byung: chos brgyud 'dzin pa shar smad lho nas dar: dam sri'i sprul pa'i mi mos ma bslus na: gter gnyis bstan pa'i pha phogs de la 'thob: tshe sgrub mthar phyin don gnyis 'bad med 'byung: gang 'brel dpal ri pad+ma 'od du 'dren: the tshom med do pad+ma'i bkas mi bslu: chos 'di las can bu yis dpal du sprod: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang zab chos yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs dam pa 'dul 'dzin pa chen po mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang*/ pad+ma'i lung zin yi ge'i 'du byed dge btsun dam pa rang gi nye gnas dam ldan tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma rnams kyis nan cher bskul 236) ngor mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo las bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes dag par gtan la phab pa dge'o//
